tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get details about the current CockroachDB Cloud organization including name, label, billing plan, and creation date.

tools.name: list_org_users
tools.description: List all members of the current CockroachDB Cloud organization with their email addresses and names.

tools.name: get_resource_count
tools.description: Get a count of clusters and folders in the organization, broken down by serverless vs dedicated and authorized vs total.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get the profile and preferences of the currently authenticated CockroachDB Cloud user.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List all CockroachDB clusters in the organization. Returns cluster name, state, version, cloud provider, regions, and connection endpoints.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific CockroachDB cluster including regions, usage limits, billing plan, and connection endpoints.

tools.name: get_cluster_usage
tools.description: Get current usage metrics for a cluster including consumed request units and storage usage in GiB.

tools.name: list_cluster_nodes
tools.description: List all nodes in a CockroachDB cluster with their status, region, and liveness information.

tools.name: delete_cluster
tools.description: Delete a CockroachDB cluster. This action is irreversible. The cluster must not have delete protection enabled.

tools.name: set_delete_protection
tools.description: Enable or disable delete protection on a CockroachDB cluster. When enabled, the cluster cannot be deleted until protection is removed.

tools.name: list_database_names
tools.description: List all database names in a CockroachDB cluster.

tools.name: list_database_users
tools.description: List all SQL database users in a CockroachDB cluster. Shows username and whether the user is system-internal.

tools.name: create_database_user
tools.description: Create a new SQL database user in a CockroachDB cluster with the specified password.

tools.name: delete_database_user
tools.description: Delete a SQL database user from a CockroachDB cluster.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.description: Execute one or more SQL statements against a CockroachDB cluster. Returns column names and row data for each statement. The cluster must be in CREATED state and have available capacity.

tools.name: get_networking_config
tools.description: Get the networking configuration for a cluster including IP allowlist entries and private endpoint settings.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List all invoices for the organization. Returns invoice period, amounts due and paid.

tools.name: get_credit_trial_status
tools.description: Get the credit trial status for the current organization, including remaining credits and trial expiration.
